explanation: Classic address poisoning attack on Polygon. The attacker generated a vanity address sharing the first 7 and last 4 hex characters of the vendor's approved destination, then sent a zero-value transaction to the payer's wallet 18 hours before the payment was due — inserting the lookalike into the payer's recent-transaction history. When the operator copied the recipient from history rather than the approved address book, 12500 USDC was sent to the attacker. The poisoning transaction is on-chain and constitutes the root-cause evidence.
